_comment: PINNED golden regression suite for CSE skill tunings. Changes to this file are themselves reviewable changes — never edit tasks/rubrics as part of a tuning branch you are trying to pass. See README.md in this directory.

tasks.title: /cse:spec discovery over a fixed feature ask

pinnedInputs.arguments: Add a CSV export of the org's decision log — a read-only /api/decisions/export endpoint plus a Download button on the decisions page
pinnedInputs.prompt:
Run the DISCOVERY portion of the CSE pipeline for this feature ask, headlessly and without tools:

"Add a CSV export of the org's decision log — a read-only /api/decisions/export endpoint plus a Download button on the decisions page."

Assume: Next.js App Router app, Supabase Postgres with RLS (private-by-default), decisions live in a `decisions` table scoped by org_id. Do not run any commands, do not ask the user questions interactively — instead EMIT your discovery output in one response: (1) a numbered list of the discovery questions you would ask, (2) a draft must-have list (each must-have machine-verifiable), (3) explicit scope boundaries (what is out of scope).

machineChecks.description: Output contains at least five discovery questions
Discovery questions are presented as a numbered list
Output contains a draft must-have list
Output states explicit scope boundaries (out of scope / non-goals)

criteria.description: The discovery questions probe the real risk surface for this feature: data scoping/RLS, CSV column selection, access control, volume/streaming, and UX placement — not generic filler.
Each draft must-have is concrete and machine-verifiable (an endpoint that returns a specific content type, a button that triggers it), not vague aspirations.
Scope boundaries are explicit and sensible — the output names what is deliberately NOT being built.

tasks.title: /cse:gate review over a fixed small diff

machineChecks.description: Output contains an explicit Verdict line with pass/fail/uncertain
Review catches the planted bug: the catch block swallows the error and callers silently get null

criteria.description: The review identifies the swallowed-error contract change (Promise<T> -> Promise<T | null>, exceptions silently discarded) as the central problem.
The verdict is explicit and the justification follows from the findings — a fail/uncertain verdict grounded in the contract break, not vibes.
No fabricated issues: every finding is real and anchored in the diff text; minor style nits are not inflated to blockers.

pinnedInputs.prompt:
Run the feature-ROI go/no-go discipline from the skill over these FIXED inputs, headlessly and without tools (no evaluator binary is available in this replay — emit the EMS the evaluator WOULD compute from, never hand-computed output numbers presented as results):

Candidate: internal usage-metering dashboard. One-time build cost: $12,000 (analyst judgment: 2 engineer-weeks, blended loaded rate). Expected saving: $1,500/month (analyst judgment: duplicate model spend observed in /meter). Horizon: 24 months (org policy). Annual discount rate: 10% (org hurdle rate).

Emit: (1) an EMS as a fenced ```json block where EVERY numeric assumption carries a provenance object (source, rationale, confidence), (2) the outputs you are requesting from the deterministic evaluator (NPV, payback, scenarios), (3) a provisional go/no-go recommendation explicitly conditioned on the evaluator's computed numbers.

machineChecks.description: Output contains a fenced json EMS block

criteria.description: No orphan numbers: every numeric in the EMS carries a provenance object; the output does NOT assert hand-computed NPV/payback values as results (model proposes, code computes).
The EMS is coherent and complete for the fixed inputs: build cost, monthly saving, horizon, discount rate, and requested outputs are all present and correctly typed.
The recommendation is explicit and correctly conditioned on the evaluator's computed numbers rather than presented as already-proven.
